items.title: Novo Nordisk Seeks Injunction Against Eli Lilly in Dispute Over Weight-Loss Ads
items.summary: Novo Nordisk  said it is asking a U.S. court to preliminarily halt rival  Eli Lilly  from advertising weight-loss drugs, days after accusing the Indianapolis drugmaker of using deceptive ads to mislead consumers in a lawsuit.  Novo Nordisk said the motion, to be filed on Aug. 17, will ask the court to stop Eli Lilly from advertising its GLP-1 weight-loss drugs while the lawsuit proceeds.  A spokesperson for Eli Lilly didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment Friday.
